links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated hypertension patient education materials versus recommended thresholds
links.effect: Low FRES and grade-level indices generally exceeded recommended thresholds; DeepSeek-R1 median FRES ~42.14, FKGL ~10.10; Qwen3-Max-Thinking-Preview FRES ~16.82, FKGL ~14.38.
links.quote: Readability remained challenging, with low FRES values and grade-level indices generally exceeding commonly recommended thresholds for patient education materials.

screen.reason: Evaluates patient education materials generated by six LLMs on quality, readability, and actionability metrics without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
